tool.name: team-task-create
tool.description:
Creates a new task in the caller's team's shared task store and returns the generated taskId + initial status.
**Parameters**: - `subject`: short task title (required). - `description`: longer task description (optional). - `blockedBy`: comma-separated list of dependency task IDs (optional, stored verbatim; the task DAG resolves them at flow-execution time).
**Semantics**: - The caller's team is resolved via session reverse-lookup (no teamId parameter). - ACL: `create` action requires WRITE (LEAD/MEMBER allowed, non-members denied). - Honest fail-loud: if team functionality or the team task store is not enabled (NoOp defaults) the tool reports the task was NOT created — it never returns a fake taskId.
